prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original full-body character pixel-art concept for a Chinese cultivation RPG, portrait 2:3. Crucial style: authentic hand-placed Japanese RPG pixel character art, NOT a detailed illustration with pixel filter. Character should visually have only about 90 pixels of height, enlarged with crisp nearest-neighbor square steps. Large economical connected color clusters, restrained 24-color palette, 3 shades per material, strong dark selective contour. Face readable using just a few pixels, eyes 1-2 pixel marks, hair in 5 large angular locks, clothing folds in 3-4 large shapes. Inspired in general by compact pixel-art swordsman character sheets and elegant teal/gold pixel robe portraits. Subject: Qingyun outer-sect senior male disciple, young adult, black tousled hair loosely tied back, ivory shirt, sage-teal sleeveless outer robe, charcoal wide trousers, brown waist sash and boots; a simple sheathed sword at his waist, holding a small luminous jade beast-control seal in one raised hand. Relaxed confident three-quarter standing pose, normal stylized RPG proportions around 5.5 heads tall, entire feet visible. Beautiful silhouette, character fills 80% of height. Lighting: restrained HD2D-inspired amber side light and localized pale green seal light reflected on hand and sleeve, deep desaturated blue shadow planes, ALL shading expressed in solid stepped pixel clusters. Dark contact shadow under boots. Backdrop: plain warm gray parchment color with a very simple muted circular jade motif and a few square magical motes, small stone footing only. Strong shape design, intentional negative space. Avoid complex landscape, cinematic photography, smooth gradients, volumetric fog, soft bloom, realistic rendering, tiny embroidery, fine hair strands, noisy textures, excessive details, antialiased edges, typography, labels, watermark. The result must look like a real low-resolution handcrafted sprite portrait, with excellent shape economy and subtle colored light.
